textbookText: 8. Which of the following molecules is tetra atomic?
a. Ozone b. Ammonium chloride c. Glucose d. Ammonia
9. Calcium compounds are used to repair the fractured bones. Which of the following compounds is used for this purpose?
a. CaSO4 b. CaSO4.H2O c. CaSO4.2H2O d. CaSO4.1/2 H2O
10. Which of the following compounds has the same empirical formula and molecular formula?
a. Glucose b. Sucrose c. Ethanol d. Carbon tetrachloride
11. What is the percentage composition of water in CuSO4.5H2O? [Atomic mass of Cu is 63.5 amu)
12. Which of the following is heaviest?
a. 100 atoms of nitrogen b. 30 molecules of ammonia c. 20 molecule of calcium carbonate d. 10 molecules of oxygen
B. Short answer questions 1. Define chemistry? How does study of chemistry help in the development of society?

Write any four points. 2. Why is chemistry called central science? Write the role of chemistry in agriculture and medicine in two points for each. 3. Gypsum is a one of the minerals having the molecular formula CaSO4. 2H2O is commonly used in the preparation of plaster of Paris.

a. How many atoms are there in a molecule of gypsum? b. Calculate the molecular mass of gypsum. c. Why is it used in making plaster of Paris? d. Calculate the percentage composition of sulphate in the given compound.
